visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Kai, a man with styled dark hair, stands in a cramped shop aisle. To his right, numerous sun hats and caps are displayed on racks. To his left are metal storage lockers with various labels. He speaks animatedly, using hand gestures and looking directly at the camera. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Scene cuts to an exterior shot of Kai on a city sidewalk. Modern buildings and a grey SUV are visible in the background. The lighting is bright natural daylight. He wears a black t-shirt and white wireless earbuds while continuing his address. (3) Kai stands inside the shop again, pointing up at a wall of colorful signboards displaying various beauty-related logos. He then walks through a glass door into a professional-looking makeup studio and office area. (4) Inside the studio, Kai introduces Ginny, a woman with vibrant red hair and glasses. She stands behind a glass display counter filled with makeup brushes. The background features tall cabinets packed with makeup bottles and jars under bright studio lights. (5) A series of close-up shots show various makeup products. Hands open clear plastic cases to reveal cream palettes in shades of pink, red, and beige. A hand applies color swatches to a tattooed forearm to demonstrate pigmentation and texture. (6) More brands are showcased, including CINEMA SECRETS and ESUM concealer palettes. Detailed close-ups highlight the different color options. Kai's and Ginny's hands are seen manipulating the products throughout. (7) An airbrush machine branded 'elementtwo' is demonstrated. Liquid makeup is dropped into the metal cup, and the device is used to spray a fine mist of pink pigment onto a hand. (8) Final shot of Kai and Ginny standing together in the brightly lit shop, waving and smiling toward the camera as they conclude the segment.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is a makeup store/studio filled with organized shelves of cosmetics, professional lighting, and storage lockers. A brief outdoor scene shows a standard Taipei urban street with buildings and parked cars.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice (Kai) delivers a rapid Mandarin introduction. Pitch is moderately high (4), and the tone is enthusiastic. An upbeat electronic BGM with a steady 4-on-the-floor kick drum (BPM ~124) starts immediately, providing a rhythmic backbone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition to an outdoor scene. The male vocal continues with minimal interference from faint urban background hum. (3) Returning indoors, the acoustic environment shifts back to clean studio silence. A female voice (Ginny) is introduced, speaking with a professional and friendly tone. She has a mid-range pitch and clear articulation. (4) As makeup palettes are manipulated, soft clicking and rustling sounds of plastic packaging are audible. The BGM remains constant, balanced slightly below the dialogue. (5) A continuous mechanical hum and hissing sound (SFX) characterize the demonstration of the airbrush tool. The voices remain the primary focus, easily heard over the machine's sound. (6) The video ends with an overlapping energetic exchange between both speakers, followed by a quick musical swell and a clean fade to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Store Tour -> Product Demonstration -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and promote a specialized professional makeup store in Taipei. By showcasing high-quality international brands and professional tools like airbrushes, the creator positions the store as a premier destination for makeup enthusiasts and professionals seeking hard-to-find cosmetic products.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on visiting a specific retail location and demonstrating various brands sold there, with explicit calls to action for viewers to visit.
